title: RNA sequencing of FACS-sorted cell populations from inflamed and non-inflamed endoscopic biopsies of patients with IBD, or from blood of patients with IBD and healthy donors
description: biopsies from the most inflamed area were sequenced where applicable. FACS-sorted cell populations: N=neutrophils; M=mononuclear phagocytes; S=stromal cells; E=eosinophils Overall design: SmartSeq2 RNA-sequencing, transcript quantification
